I'm honored to be a member of the Sansasyonel project team.

Below, you'll find a brief summary of our project. To access a detailed project description, please go to [https://github.com/emu-hacettepe-analytics/emu430-fall2024-team-sansasyonel]()

**Summary**

Our project for EMU430 Data Analytics investigates
Turkey's housing market using official data from TCMB and TUIK, covering the
period 2010 to 2024.
 
The question we started with was simple: has Turkish housing actually gotten
more expensive, or does it just look that way because of inflation? The answer
turned out to be more nuanced than we expected.
